claims.statement: Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised a free concert in the evening (printed as 'bikie te evening'), with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: the-world, 619 Market street. Free concert bikie te evening; best of singers only engaged

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: Tom ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the-world, 619 Market street

notes: Advertisement only. The hint said 'every evening'; the text reads 'bikie te evening' (OCR), so 'every' is not confirmed.
